description: Regression values of this repository (not literature values): structural-sensitivity (wavemaker) field of the Re=100 cylinder from the direct and adjoint modes. Giannetti and Luchini (2007) place the wavemaker inside the recirculation bubble; here x_peak = 3.84 lies inside the bubble of the steady base flow.

wavemaker_xpeak.note: Streamwise position of the wavemaker maximum, in cylinder diameters from the cylinder centre.
